model.label: The Model
model.title: Two Arms, One Mission
paragraphs: YuDevelopment operates as the golden goose of YGCCC through a deliberate dual-arm structure. The first arm — Development Services — provides architectural coordination, consulting, feasibility analysis, and entitlement support to third-party clients, generating the cash flow that funds operations.

The second arm — Internal Development — deploys that capital into YGCCC-owned multifamily projects. This is where long-term wealth is built: through market identification, land sourcing, investor relations, deal structuring, and project oversight on assets we own.
The result is a self-funding development platform where services revenue fuels equity creation — no external operating capital required for the machine to run.

values.title: Long-Term Vision
